items.headline: Ai Benchmarks are useless
items.summary: I'm done with the launch cycle. Every new model drops with the same flashy report, bar charts all over the place, hitting 92% on MMLU-Pro, 94% on GPQA, or whatever coding benchmark they're pushing this week. Then you plug it into a real workflow through the API, or try to run it on an actual multi-step project that's not some tidy puzzle, and it feels like a step back from what we had a year ago.
